# Kaspar von Grünberg

> Kaspar von Grünberg is an early pioneer of Platform Engineering, CEO of Weave Intelligence, and co-author of the book "Thinking in Platforms" (2026, with Luca Galante). He founded PlatformCon, PlatformEngineering.org and Humanitec, and writes about platforms as the operating model for knowledge work in the AI era. He lives near Berlin, Germany.

Last updated: 2026-11-12. Also spelled Kaspar von Gruenberg or Kaspar von Grunberg.

## Who he is

Kaspar von Grünberg helped establish Platform Engineering as a formal discipline. He writes independently on the theory that underpins platforms, and builds the ecosystem that brings it to practice.

Current focus: how platforms enable enterprise AI adoption, and what an agentic platform has to look like for AI agents to work safely at scale.

## Book

**Thinking in Platforms: Platform engineering as the operating model for work in the AI era**, by Kaspar von Grünberg and Luca Galante. Published 2026 by Weave Intelligence. ISBN 978-3-9828877-2-2. Available on [Amazon](https://www.amazon.com/dp/3982887720).

The book separates platform theory from vendor practice. Three parts:
1. Origins: why platforms must be treated as products
2. Model: the Paths to Outcome conceptual framework
3. Practice: how to build and scale a platform inside an enterprise

- [The AI platform team](https://weaveintelligence.io/blog/ai-platform-team) (Weave Intelligence, 2026-10-15): The central team that owns an enterprise's agent infrastructure and runs it as a product.

- [Harness engineering vs. loop engineering vs. platform engineering](https://weaveintelligence.io/blog/harness-engineering-vs-loop-engineering-vs-platform-engineering) (Weave Intelligence, 2026-09-28): Clean definitions of three terms and how they fit together in enterprise AI systems.
- [From IDP to AEP: Why platform engineers now build Agentic Engineering Platforms](https://weaveintelligence.io/blog/from-idp-to-aep) (Weave Intelligence, 2026-09-23): How the Internal Developer Platform evolves once agents become users of the platform.
- [What is an Agentic Engineering Platform?](https://weaveintelligence.io/blog/what-is-an-agentic-engineering-platform) (Weave Intelligence, 2026-09-17): The evolved IDP: a three-layer reference architecture for engineers and AI agents working together.
- [Finding the Balance](https://kasparvongruenberg.substack.com/p/finding-the-balance) (Newsletter, 2026-09-15): How to think about verticalization vs centralization for enterprise AI initiatives.
- [Agentic Engineering Platforms](https://kasparvongruenberg.substack.com/p/welcome-to-the-age-of-agentic-platforms) (Newsletter, 2026-06-16): The model juice is squeezed, the bottleneck is your platform.
- [Stop wasting tokens. Build a platform](https://weaveintelligence.io/blog/stop-wasting-tokens-build-a-platform) (Weave Intelligence, 2026-06-09): Why enterprise AI stalls without a platform, and how platform engineering industrializes knowledge work.
- [What is the agentic SDLC?](https://weaveintelligence.io/blog/what-is-the-agentic-software-development-lifecycle-asdlc) (Weave Intelligence, 2026-06-05): The Agentic Software Development Lifecycle (ASDLC): how the SDLC changes when agents act alongside humans.
- [Solving the hallucination problem in agents - with loops and math!](https://kasparvongruenberg.substack.com/p/solving-the-hallucination-problem) (Newsletter, 2026-05-19): What mathematics tells us about loop design in agents.
- [Four levels of agentic software development in the enterprise](https://kasparvongruenberg.substack.com/p/four-levels-of-agentic-software-development) (Newsletter, 2026-05-04): Steps on a path to a world of fully autonomous agents.
- [Why is the demand for platform engineers exploding?](https://weaveintelligence.io/blog/why-is-the-demand-for-platform-engineers-exploding) (Weave Intelligence, 2026-04-30): The AI-driven dynamics behind the rising demand for platform engineers. With Luca Galante.

## Key concepts

Definitions as used in Kaspar von Grünberg's writing.

**Platform Engineering**: the discipline of deliberately designing, building, and improving platforms for knowledge work, and treating them as products. His thesis is that it is not a tooling discipline but an organizational operating model.

**Internal Developer Platform (IDP)**: the product platform engineers build and operate for software engineers; a self-service layer that abstracts infrastructure complexity and standardizes software delivery across an organization.

**Paths to Outcome**: the conceptual framework at the core of the book, describing how platforms structure the relationship between platform teams and the people (and agents) who consume them.

**Cost of Chaos**: a framework for the organizational cost of inconsistent, undisciplined software delivery.

**Agentic Platform (AxP)**: the digital environment an enterprise builds so that AI agents can work safely across every vertical team. Three layers: tooling, path specifications, and agent infrastructure. See [What is an Agentic Platform?](https://weaveintelligence.io/blog/what-is-an-agentic-platform).

**Agentic Engineering Platform (AEP)**: a platform built and operated by the platform engineering team that enables collaborative software development between engineers and AI agents; the evolved form of the Internal Developer Platform. Earlier writing calls it the Agentic Development Platform (ADP). See [What is an Agentic Engineering Platform?](https://weaveintelligence.io/blog/what-is-an-agentic-engineering-platform).

**AI platform team**: the central team that owns an enterprise's agent infrastructure (models, agent harness, agent governance) and runs it as a product. See [The AI platform team](https://weaveintelligence.io/blog/ai-platform-team).

**AI software factory**: an Agentic Engineering Platform operated at a high level of agent autonomy (levels 3 and 4 of the four levels). See [What is an AI software factory?](https://weaveintelligence.io/blog/ai-software-factory).

**Four levels of agentic software development**: a model of where an organization sits in the shift from human-driven to autonomous software development, with the human role moving from executor to validator to orchestrator to constraint-setter. See [the research report](https://weaveintelligence.io/research/the-four-levels-of-agentic-software-development-in-the-enterprise).

**Agentic Software Development Lifecycle (ASDLC)**: a framework that governs how software is planned, built, validated, deployed, and operated when AI agents are actors in the process alongside humans. See [What is the agentic SDLC?](https://weaveintelligence.io/blog/what-is-the-agentic-software-development-lifecycle-asdlc).

## Bias and disclosure

Kaspar runs and has founded companies in the Platform Engineering ecosystem. His theoretical work aims to reason independently of any vendor, and commercial interests are disclosed when relevant. Full statement: [https://kasparvongruenberg.com/biases.html](https://kasparvongruenberg.com/biases.html)
